description: Routine updates come once a week, a few grouped pull requests rather than one per dependency; each major version still gets its own, and security fixes come at once.

customManagers.description: deploy/Dockerfile installs pnpm by version for the web build; web/package.json's packageManager names the same one for CI.

packageRules.description: The release workflow can push images and mint signing identities, so its actions stay pinned to commit digests; Renovate updates the digest and the version comment together.
Base images are pinned by digest in deploy/Dockerfile so a release rebuilt from its tag uses the same bases.
Rust crates, minor and patch, in one pull request a week. A 0.x crate's minor version is a breaking one, so it is left to come on its own, as a major does.
The web UI's packages, minor and patch, in one pull request a week, 0.x minors excepted as for Rust.
GitHub Actions, short of a major, in one pull request a week.
Container images (the Dockerfile's bases, CI's service containers), short of a major, in one pull request a week.
The Rust toolchain moves rust-toolchain.toml, CI's container and the Dockerfile's build stage together, and a new one brings new lints, so it comes on its own.
pnpm is named twice, by web/package.json for CI and by deploy/Dockerfile for the image, and the two move together.
TypeScript stays below 7 until the tools that run it say they take 7: svelte-check declares TypeScript 5 or 6, and typescript-eslint below 6.1. SvelteKit 3 asks for 6.
The overrides in web/pnpm-workspace.yaml force a patched release of a dependency's own major, so a new major is never the fix there.
PostgreSQL major versions need a dump and restore, so they are never proposed as an ordinary update.
